
```r
work_dir = "/storage/home/kangsm/analysis/gcx.pipeline.use.hmftools.in.wes/03.analysis"

data_dir = "/storage/home/kangsm/analysis/gcx.pipeline.use.hmftools.in.wes/02.data_processing"

samplelist=list.files(data_dir, pattern="WES-T" )
samplegroup1=sapply(samplelist, function(y) paste0(unlist(strsplit(y, "\\-"))[1:3], collapse="-") )

SAMPLE_SHEET = data.frame()

for( j in 1:length(samplelist) ){
    
    sinfo = rbind(
        data.frame( 
            group_id=sprintf("PATIENT%s", j),
            subject_id=sprintf("PATIENT%s", j),
            sample_id=samplelist[j],
            sample_type="tumor",
            sequence_type="dna",
            filetype="bam",
            filepath=sprintf("%s/%s/bam/%s.hmftools.bwa.mem2.bam",data_dir,samplelist[j],samplelist[j])
        ),
        data.frame( 
            group_id=sprintf("PATIENT%s", j),
            subject_id=sprintf("PATIENT%s", j),
            sample_id=samplelist[j],
            sample_type="tumor",
            sequence_type="dna",
            filetype="bai",
            filepath=sprintf("%s/%s/bam/%s.hmftools.bwa.mem2.bam.bai",data_dir,samplelist[j],samplelist[j])
        )
    )

    SAMPLE_SHEET = rbind(SAMPLE_SHEET, sinfo)
}
```
